decisions.briefing: Markets were neutral today with NASDAQ -0.8% and S&P 500 -0.2%, not the kind of risk-on move that justifies deploying capital. Cash on hand ($89.29) is also far below the $500 threshold needed to add a new position, so we're holding all 7 existing positions and letting stop-loss/profit-target rules manage them automatically.

market_education.summary_en: Both major indices slipped modestly today, with the NASDAQ underperforming the S&P 500, suggesting a mild pullback in growth and tech-heavy names rather than a broad risk-off event. There's no single dominant catalyst visible in today's data — this looks like normal day-to-day consolidation after recent gains. With no strong directional signal, sitting on the sidelines for new buys is the more prudent choice.
market_education.summary_zh: 今天兩大指數皆小幅走弱，納斯達克跌幅大於標普500，顯示成長股與科技股承受較大壓力，但尚不足以構成全面性的風險規避行情。目前數據中看不出明顯的單一觸發因素，較像是近期漲勢後的正常整理。在缺乏明確方向訊號的情況下，暫緩加碼新倉是較穩健的做法。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors pull back from riskier assets like growth stocks, often shown by indices like the NASDAQ underperforming. On days like this, disciplined investors avoid chasing new trades and instead protect their existing gains — patience is itself a strategy.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險規避」（Risk-Off）是指投資人減少持有風險性資產（如成長股），通常表現為納斯達克等指數表現落後。在這樣的日子，有紀律的投資人會避免追高進場，而是專注於保護既有獲利——耐心本身就是一種策略。
